original_hypothesis: Isshin doubles the teammate's Najeela triggers.
finding: Isshin only doubles qualifying abilities of permanents its controller controls. It does not double an allied Najeela.
Wulfgar's controller and attacking-creature restrictions do not extend to the allied Najeela's permanent abilities.

original_hypothesis: K'rrik's life payments draw cards for the ally's Vilis.
finding: The life-loss event belongs to K'rrik's controller. Shared life does not make Vilis's controller lose that life for Vilis's trigger.

original_hypothesis: An ally's payments increase Rowan's life-lost reduction.
finding: Rowan counts life its controller lost this turn, not every reduction of the shared pool caused by the teammate.

original_hypothesis: Oloro's life gain directly triggers allied Vito.
finding: Vito requires its own controller to gain life. Oloro's gain changes shared life but does not become Vito's controller's gain event.

original_hypothesis: Feather casts a cantrip at the ally's Zada and both engines trigger.
finding: Zada requires Zada's controller to cast the spell; Feather requires its controller to cast a spell targeting a creature that player controls. Splitting those two commanders does not reproduce that claimed same-controller engine.

original_hypothesis: Adeline's allied tokens trigger Toski like Edric.
finding: Toski only rewards combat damage by creatures Toski's controller controls. Edric's wording is different.

original_hypothesis: Volrath places a minus-one counter and the ally's Hapatra makes a Snake.
finding: Hapatra requires its own controller to put the counters. The teammate placing them is not that player.

original_hypothesis: Jegantha directly pays the teammate's Sisay activation.
finding: Jegantha adds mana to its controller's pool. Sisay's controller cannot spend the ally's pool absent a separate explicit permission.

original_hypothesis: Zirda reduces the teammate's Kenrith activations.
finding: Zirda discounts abilities its own controller activates. Kenrith does not let any player activate its abilities, unlike Xantcha.

original_hypothesis: An ally-owned Curiosity on Niv creates the usual draw-damage loop.
finding: Curiosity's you-draw instruction belongs to its Aura controller. The teammate drawing does not trigger Niv's own-controller draw ability. A separate same-controller configuration can work.

original_hypothesis: Both opposing heads provide unequal-life Breena attack rewards.
finding: Both opposing players read the same shared life total, so one cannot have more life than the other for Breena's condition in this two-team configuration.

original_hypothesis: Goad prevents the opposing team from attacking either ally.
finding: A goad effect tells creatures to attack a player other than that effect's controller if able. The other teammate can still be a legal attacked player; this is not a teamwide safety lock.

original_hypothesis: Perrie counts every counter type on the team's combined board.
finding: Perrie counts permanents its controller controls. An ally's counter types do not expand that count merely because life and turns are shared.
